company_name: Chunghwa Precision Test Tech. Co., Ltd
semiconductor_relevance: High — Chunghwa Precision Test Tech. Co., Ltd. specializes in providing test solutions, particularly in the area of probe cards and load boards for semiconductor testing.
summary: Chunghwa Precision Test Tech. Co., Ltd. (CHPT) offers comprehensive testing solutions for the semiconductor industry, focusing on vertical probe cards, load boards, and DUT boards. With a strong emphasis on R&D, design, and manufacturing, CHPT aims to deliver customized and efficient services to enhance customer competitiveness in the fast-evolving semiconductor market.
capabilities: PCB layout design and assembly services

regional_presence.Taiwan: CHPT is located in Pingzhen Industrial Park, Taoyuan City, Taiwan, and has established itself as a key player in the local semiconductor testing market.
